summary: VP, Portfolio Management, Investing & Oversight candidate with seven years across institutional investment-risk platforms, portfolio analytics, and model governance. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-level risk outputs for institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and supported the migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy platform (Calypso) to Moody's PFaroe platform. Translates investment-team requirements into technology delivery, working across investment, risk, and product/development stakeholders. CFA charter; dual MSc.
core_skills: Institutional Investment-Risk Platform Delivery & Client Migration
Requirements Scoping for Product & Technology Teams

experience.employer: Moody's Analytics - Asset Management & Buy-Side Solutions

sections.heading: Portfolio Analytics, Insights & Oversight
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-level risk outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics that feed downstream portfolio and reporting processes.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, cross-checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates.
Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Auditability & Escalation
bullets: Serves on Moody's model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and performance assessment for the firm's quantitative and valuation models used in client-delivered analytics.

Operates within a formal model-governance framework covering independent review and challenge, assumption validation, and escalation of outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with clients' Heads of Risk.

sections.heading: Platform Workflows & Operational Efficiency
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Designed and implemented an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.

sections.heading: Client Onboarding & Requirements Translation
bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating onto the PFaroe DB (risk analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) investment platforms.
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into structured development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Advised pension and institutional clients on Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Delivered ALM and liability-driven investment (LDI) studies for Canadian and international pension funds covering funding ratios, duration alignment, and liquidity trade-offs.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
